name: metroconnect-departures
description: Check selected NJ Transit train departures and PATH arrival predictions.

interface.longDescription: Find supported NJ Transit rail and PATH stations and check cached station boards. NJ Transit results show scheduled departures, reported status and tracks when supplied. PATH results show arrival predictions. Source timestamps and stale-data handling make limitations explicit. Independent AI Gaur LLC service. No tickets, fares, full routing, future timetables, location tracking or guaranteed accessibility. No personal account connection required.
defaultPrompt: Show upcoming NJ Transit trains at Edison.
Find Newark Penn and show which station IDs are supported.
Check PATH arrival predictions at Journal Square.

positive.expected_behavior: Return both NJT and PATH station IDs; do not silently pick one.

positive.prompt: Show NJ Transit departures at Edison.
positive.expected_behavior: Use NJT:ED and preserve source, cache age, reported status and unknown tracks.

positive.prompt: Show PATH arrival predictions at Journal Square.
positive.expected_behavior: Use PATH:JSQ and distinguish predicted arrivals from scheduled departures.
Use empty search to list the supported catalog only; do not claim full network coverage.

positive.prompt: Does MetroConnect support Boston South Station?
positive.expected_behavior: Return no supported match and explain the connector covers selected NJ Transit and PATH stations.

negative.prompt: Buy a train ticket and guarantee an accessible route tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain unsupported tickets, future routing and accessibility verification. Do not fabricate actions.

publication.release_notes: Initial station-board beta. Two read-only tools. Review walkthrough uses captured screens from a real Claude test, including source timestamps and coverage limits.
